description: The resource documents original and modified multi-objective particle-swarm methods for water-network design, with pseudocode, explanations and an example. This resource is provided by Mohamed Reyad Torkomany. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The proposed changes target convergence and solution diversity; those effects were not independently reproduced. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
